summary: The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the equity securities (the “Equity Securities”) held by the Amplify Cybersecurity ETF (the “HACK ETF”), a series of the Amplify ETF Trust advised by Amplify Investments, LLC, the investment adviser to the fund (“Amplify Investments” or the “Adviser”), and written covered call option contracts that reference the Equity Securities. It is non-diversified.
